items.title: The pullback of a sheaf of sets on the pro-etale site evaluated on an affine weakly contractible object
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a morphism f : X -> Y and a sheaf of sets F on the pro-etale site of Y, the value of the pullback at an affine weakly contractible object W of X is the colimit of the values of F over the morphisms W -> V over Y (statement lines 3499-3509). The proof (proof lines 3511-3538) identifies the pullback as the sheafification of a colimit presheaf, proves through an initiality argument that this presheaf sends finite disjoint unions to products, and concludes by the agreement lemma for affine weakly contractible objects. H2: two steps with three inputs, written out in full.
